rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses relevant to patient care from Board-approved sponsors: AGD-approved providers, ACCME-certified providers, ADA and its specialty organizations, ADA CERP providers, ADHA, American Academy of Dental Hygiene, ACPE, AHA, AMA, American Red Cross, CODA programs, Hawaii DOH, JCAHO hospitals, state dental/dental hygienists' associations; others need prior Board approval
rules.alternatives: Board may waive or modify CE for full-time armed forces service, incapacitating illness, disability, retirement from practice, or undue hardship (written request with renewal).
rules.audit_note: Licensee certifies compliance on the renewal application; Board may audit and require copies of attendance evidence. Keep original documentation 4 years.
rules.legal_basis: HAR Title 16, Chapter 79, Subchapter 14 (§§16-79-140 to 16-79-148); HRS §448-8.5
rules.rule_quote: …Submitting evidence of completion of the CE requirements of a minimum of thirty-two hours for licensed dentists and twenty hours for licensed dental hygienists each biennium;
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed in the first year of the biennium: 10 CE hours; licensed in the second year: none.

topics.who: Current hands-on BLS for Healthcare Providers; max 4 h credit

rules.notes: All licenses renew by December 31 of odd years. More than half of hours must be clinical. Current hands-on BLS for Healthcare Providers required (max 4 h credit). Computer/correspondence/media courses max 8 h.
